perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Cumulative primary evidence still supports Thacker Pass as a strategically relevant domestic lithium build approaching peak construction, with DOE, GM, Orion and convertible financing supporting the buildout.
A fresh issuer-domain check found no materially newer primary construction disclosure than the August 6 financing/update; novelty is not manufactured.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Designed 40,000 tpa capacity and committed financing remain inputs, not proof of realized production, qualification, cost or schedule performance.
Highest-value next evidence remains physical construction completion, commissioning progress and updated cost/contingency disclosure.

unknowns: remaining contingency versus total project cost
commissioning curve and realized operating cost
